brief:
Israeli exit polls indicate a significant surge in Palestinian voting that prevents both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and opposition candidate Eisenkot from securing enough seats to form a government, Middle East Eye reported. The results suggest neither major political faction can achieve a parliamentary majority without additional coalition partners.

The poll findings reflect substantial Palestinian electoral participation in what appears to be a pivotal shift in voting patterns. Coalition negotiations are expected to determine the composition of Israel's next government.

title: Exit polls show Palestinian gains block Netanyahu majority
